name: Anywhere But Here
summary: A veteran spirit asks you to find his scabbard near Elderwild. The craters around him recall the Third War.

sections.title: A Veteran's Request
sections.body: Near Elderwild, the Veteran of the Third War asks you to find the scabbard he left at an overlook west of his position. He remembers the view there vividly, though he has forgotten much of what he once was. The craters around him have seen few visitors in years.

faq.q: Who is asking me to find the scabbard?
faq.answer: The Veteran of the Third War, a spirit who appears near Elderwild, asks you to find his scabbard.
The Veteran says he left his scabbard at an overlook west of where he stands, near Elderwild.

faq.q: Why does the veteran mention Archimonde?
faq.answer: The veteran wonders whether Archimonde was repelled, then remarks that it has been a long time.
The Veteran of the Third War remembers the view from the overlook where he left his scabbard.

attribution: In-game quest text: Anywhere But Here
